details:
=== CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===
- README.md:3032-3034 | severity=high | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, minimax_minimax-m3, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: The `CONFLICT_MODIFY_DELETE_TAKE_BASE_ENABLED` row says a swept file deleted by a squash-merged base PR "takes the deletion without a model call" with no qualification, but the new `reason=integration_sync` skip at scripts/review_conflict_prepare.sh:693-697/693-699 makes that false on every `orchestrator/project-*` head; the agents.d fragment was updated but the README row was not.
  WHY: Operators on integration-sync runs expect a deterministic take-base and a dropped-edits comment, yet the path always goes to the model, and the README documents no `reason=integration_sync` log key. Severity disagreement: minimax rated it MAJOR; sonnet and glm rated it NIT and called it documentation drift, not a runtime failure. The highest rating is used.
- changelog.d/9886-modify-delete-take-base.md:2 | severity=high | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m3, anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: The fragment says "`scripts/review_conflict_prepare.sh` takes the deletion without a model call and posts the dropped edit on the PR" with no qualification, which is false on `orchestrator/project-*` heads after the `reason=integration_sync` skip.
  WHY: Once the fragment is folded into CHANGELOG.md, consumers and operators read a behaviour description that does not match the script on integration-sync runs. Severity disagreement: minimax rated it MAJOR; sonnet and glm raised it under their NIT README finding. The highest rating is used.
- scripts/review_conflict_prepare.sh:693-697 | severity=low | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite]
  PROBLEM: The last run added a skip that drops every path on an `orchestrator/project-*` integration-sync head, whether or not the path conflicts with the fingerprint check.
  WHY: The skip is broader than needed: modify/delete conflicts on integration branches always fall back to the model, bringing back the human wait that PR #9452 parked on. The reviewer gave no severity, so low is a default.
- scripts/review_conflict_prepare.sh:618-620 | severity=low | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite]
  PROBLEM: The block comment says every non-blank changed line is compared "sign kept, leading whitespace stripped, the path removed", but the code now strips only leading whitespace.
  WHY: The comment no longer matches the code and can mislead maintainers about how strings are normalised. The reviewer gave no severity, so low is a default.
- scripts/review_conflict_prepare.sh:647 | severity=low | confidence=3
  flagged_by: [google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite]
  PROBLEM: When `CONFLICT_MODIFY_DELETE_TAKE_BASE_ENABLED` has an unrecognised value, the script warns and continues with `_mdd_enabled=false`; the `resolve.sh` counterpart (line 753) does the same.
  WHY: An invalid value silently turns the feature off in both scripts, and only a warning tells the operator. The reviewer called this acceptable and gave no severity, so low is a default.
- scripts/review_conflict_resolve.sh:2862-2866 | severity=low | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [z-ai_glm-5_3-flash, anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5]
  PROBLEM: In `_resolver_modify_delete_context`, the two printf lines insert PR-controlled file paths raw into inline code spans in `${_rmd_block}`, which is appended to the resolver prompt. Unlike the retry prelude (scripts/review_conflict_resolve.sh:2645-2657) and the prepare-side `${_mdd_path//\`/}`, this block neither strips backticks nor fences the paths.
  WHY: A path containing a backtick can close its code span and put free text into the prompt on every attempt. Neither reviewer gave a severity (both gave HARDENING_RISK_SCORE 1; sonnet listed it as a hardening suggestion), so low is a default. Suggested fix: print `${_rmd_path//\`/}`, or "(path redacted)".
- scripts/review_conflict_resolve.sh:2893-2900 | severity=low | confidence=3
  flagged_by: [google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite]
  PROBLEM: PR-controlled file names and paths are put into the conflict resolver prompt without a data fence, so a backtick in a path can break out of the inline code span.
  WHY: A crafted file path could change the model's instructions in the rendered prompt (untrusted-input injection). The reviewer gave no severity, so low is a default. This is not merged with the 2862-2866 entry because the line ranges do not overlap.
=== END CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===

=== CONSENSUS TASK GAPS ===
- requirement: Plan Phase 4 step 1 (docs/plans/pipeline-human-wait-elimination-plan.md:258-261): "For each unmerged path with stages `1 2` (PR modified, base deleted) that is not a fragment: ... When both hold: `git rm` the path and record it in `RESOLVER_DROPPED_EDITS_FILE`." The plan excludes no branch class.
  expected_change_site: scripts/review_conflict_prepare.sh, the `# >>> non-fragment modify/delete take-base` block (around lines 593-870), plus the PR description
  confidence=4
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3, openai_gpt-6-luna, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  EVIDENCE: Lines 693-697/693-699 skip every `orchestrator/project-*` head (`outcome=skip reason=integration_sync`) before the stage-2 mode, deleting-PR and containment checks, so integration-sync conflicts never take the base and stay with the model, which is the failure shape that parked PR #9452. The deviation appears in neither the PR description, README.md:3032 nor changelog.d/9886-modify-delete-take-base.md:2; only the agents.d fragment notes it. Sonnet and glm call the skip defensible and fail-closed: merged sub-issue fingerprints load only later (around lines 1908-2145 / 1915+), so a taken path that a fingerprint names would reach `exit 1` at lines 2189-2190 with no retry state, unlike the `.ai-asset-only` and `gitleaksignore-only` hand-offs at lines 2169-2185. Their remedy is to record the deviation, or to add a `modify-delete-only` hand-off and drop the skip. Ratings: MAJOR from gemini, minimax and luna; NIT from sonnet and glm.
- requirement: "The existing resolver success summary lists each path with its deleting PR and a 10-line excerpt of the dropped diff. That reuses the existing comment; there is no new comment."
  expected_change_site: scripts/review_conflict_resolve.sh, the existing resolver success-summary comment (loop)
  confidence=5
  flagged_by: [google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, openai_gpt-6-luna]
  EVIDENCE: The PR adds a separate `modify_delete_take_base_comment.md`, posts it through `scripts/review_conflict_prepare.sh` either directly or through a new comment loop at `scripts/review_conflict_resolve.sh:5456-5477`, and does not add the dropped-edit details to the existing success summary. Both reviewers rated it NIT. Sonnet and glm did not re-flag it: they say no success-summary comment exists to extend, and earlier editor rounds accepted the deviation.
- requirement: "Remove the modify/delete rule from the static resolver prompt."
  expected_change_site: prompts/conflict-resolver.txt
  confidence=4
  flagged_by: [google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite]
  EVIDENCE: `prompts/conflict-resolver.txt` is not in the PR diff and still contains the modify/delete instruction (rated MAJOR). Sonnet and glm dispute this gap: plan step 3 puts the stage context in review_conflict_resolve.sh, the appended sentence answers the static rule at prompts/conflict-resolver.txt:50, and tests/test_review_conflict_modify_delete.py:544-546 asserts the static prompt stays unchanged when the switch is off.
- requirement: Document "takes the deletion without a model call" in the README.md and changelog.
  expected_change_site: README.md:3034 and changelog.d/9886-modify-delete-take-base.md
  confidence=4
  flagged_by: [google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite]
  EVIDENCE: The README.md row and the changelog fragment are now wrong for `orchestrator/project-*` branches, where take-base is skipped; only the agents.d fragment documents the skip (rated NIT).
=== END CONSENSUS TASK GAPS ===

=== FINDINGS FROM anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5 ===
- README.md:3034 (also changelog.d/9886-modify-delete-take-base.md:2) | severity=NIT | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: The `CONFLICT_MODIFY_DELETE_TAKE_BASE_ENABLED` row and the changelog fragment say a swept modify/delete path always takes the deletion. The skip at scripts/review_conflict_prepare.sh:693-699 (`orchestrator/project-*` → `outcome=skip reason=integration_sync`) was documented in agents.d but not in either of these.
  WHY: This is documentation drift: integration-sync heads always go to the model and get no dropped-edits comment. Fix: add "(not on `orchestrator/project-*` integration-sync heads, `reason=integration_sync`)" to both. Both lines were added by this PR, so editing them is allowed.
- TASK_GAP | severity=NIT | confidence=3
  Requirement: Plan Phase 4 step 1 (docs/plans/pipeline-human-wait-elimination-plan.md:258-261): "For each unmerged path with stages `1 2` (PR modified, base deleted) that is not a fragment: ... When both hold: `git rm` the path and record it in `RESOLVER_DROPPED_EDITS_FILE`." The plan excludes no branch class.
  Expected change site: scripts/review_conflict_prepare.sh, the `# >>> non-fragment modify/delete take-base` block, and the PR description.
  Evidence of absence: Lines 693-699 skip every orchestrator/project-* head before the mode, deleting-PR and containment checks. The skip is defensible and fails closed: fingerprints load later (around lines 1908-2145), and a deferred take-base would reach `exit 1` at lines 2189-2190 with no retry state, unlike the hand-offs at lines 2169-2185. It still deviates from the approved scope and is not recorded. Either record the deviation or add a `modify-delete-only` hand-off and drop the skip.
- HARDENING: scripts/review_conflict_resolve.sh, `_resolver_modify_delete_context`, the two `printf -- '- \`%s\`: deleted on ...'` lines into "${_rmd_block}" | HARDENING_RISK_SCORE=1
  PROBLEM: PR-controlled paths go into the trusted part of the prompt inside inline code spans, with no fence and no backtick stripping, unlike the fenced unmerged_left retry prelude.
  WHY: A backtick in a path can close the code span and inject free text. Fix: `local _rmd_shown="${_rmd_path//\`/}"`, or print "(path redacted)" when `_resolver_mdd_log_path` returns `redacted`. About 2-3 lines.
- NOTE: Sonnet rejected two items from other reviewers (2 related items). (1) The prompts/conflict-resolver.txt gap (gemini): plan step 3 puts the stage context in resolve.sh, the appended sentence answers the static rule at prompts/conflict-resolver.txt:50, and leaving the file unchanged keeps the `=false` rollback exact. (2) The success-summary gap (luna): resolve.sh has no success-summary comment to extend, and its only PR-comment posts are at lines 990-992, 4043 and 5467-5469; earlier editors accepted the deviation.
=== END FINDINGS FROM anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5 ===
